scope: Schlumprecht, Seeger and Hong Wang report integration; local build and browser verification, not publication or complete research-proof reproduction.

mathematical_review.scope: The parent read all new mathematical pages and surveyed the explicit hypotheses, local arguments, direct prerequisites and cited-result boundaries. Each report record preserves the source-reading scope and deferred branches. No independent reproduction of the cited research proofs is claimed.
source_corrections: Use coordinate-labelled Hilbert vectors for the Hamming metric; retain separability and the lower-lp/upper-lq exponent order.
Use the original game/tree and strategic-reproducibility papers for their quantified definitions rather than treating abbreviated report formulas as complete statements.
Distinguish uniform Minkowski dimension, ordinary/upper Assouad spectra and quasi-Assouad dimension; correct the Q4 denominator and the Legendre-condition sign.
Distinguish closure of a type region from endpoint strong boundedness and countable-radius differentiation from the continuous-parameter theorem.

Correct the restricted-direction supremum, normal vector, positive covering exponent, invalid unit-ball quadric example and slicing implication; retain the fake induction as a parameter-loss counterexample.

limits: 48 theorem-class pages contain local arguments; five explicitly use external research inputs. Another 27 theorem-class pages cite their main results without local proofs.
Szlenk-index theory and other deferred Schlumprecht branches, selected companion-survey branches for Seeger and deep projection/Kakeya machinery remain as specified in the report records.
Structural, formula and browser checks do not establish mathematical correctness of all 4397 existing pages. Terminology verification against Banana Space was unavailable and is not claimed.
